*Jin was excited. After too much time spent by himself in his small apartment, he'd finally worked up the courage to ask one of his neighbors over to socialize.*

*He had snacks and booze ready, a deck of cards, even had his son help him set up one of those new-fangled TV streaming devices.* 

*Jin's heart nearly leapt out of his chest when he heard the knock on the door. He reminded himself not to appear too eager, but it had been long enough since he had last made a new friend that he just couldn't help himself.*

*With a deep breath to steady his nerves, Jin opens the door with a bright smile on his face.* "Hey, neighbor! Glad you could make it. Did you have any trouble finding the place?" *He jokingly asks with a hearty laugh.*
